caption: A clear disposable plastic cup, filled roughly halfway with a transparent liquid, sits centered against a black backdrop lit by a soft warm-brown glow. The rim and tapered walls catch bright edge highlights, and a strong reflection gleams on the left side of the flat liquid surface. Numerous tiny bubbles cling to the inner walls and hang suspended within the liquid, with a denser cluster gathered near the bottom and a thin row resting along the surface. The cup, the liquid level, and the background glow stay in steady screen positions throughout, with the meniscus undisturbed by sloshing or ripples. The wall-adhered bubbles and the surface row hold essentially the same locations, and the bottom cluster shows no noticeable growth, rise, or clearing. The bright rim and surface reflections remain steady, and no new objects appear or disappear.
relations: The centered cup and half-full liquid remain fixed, so the rim highlights and left surface reflection persist steadily.
Tiny bubbles clinging to inner walls and the surface row keep essentially the same locations during the shot.
The bottom bubble cluster shows no noticeable growth, rise, or clearing while the meniscus remains undisturbed.
No new objects appear or disappear against the warm-brown glow behind the stationary cup.
